correctness.rationale: All feasible profiles are characterized by k,t positive symbol run counts and realized by an explicit representative. Half-L1 distance equals max(|delta k|,|delta t|)+|delta t| and corrects one arbitrary read misclassification exactly at separation >=3. Recursive 4-clique partition proves at most m² mixed profiles, and residue zero mod 4 gives one per clique with constant endpoints at distance >=3, hence exact m²+2 for n=4m. Monotone injection yields sharp n²/16+O(n). A direct standard-library checker passed all specified finite tests.

value.rationale: Exactly solves the maximum number of zero-error messages for a standard noisy unordered cyclic pair-read channel at infinitely many blocklengths, with tight finite and asymptotic bounds. The result is a nontrivial geometric packing certificate (recursive clique upper bound plus residue construction), not merely counting clean histograms; it isolates the effect of one read misclassification.
